name: Nia FitPatches
voice_description: A native Bulgarian woman, 27, speaking fluent, natural, standard Bulgarian with a Sofia accent and correct Bulgarian stress. Relaxed conversational pace with natural pauses and small breaths, clear diction, mid-pitch, never an announcer or advertising tone.
